meta_data.base_class: Test the adaptability of <speech processing tasks> to different accents - refers to various computational tasks involving the processing of speech signals.

tool_template.name: <class>AccentAdaptationTest
tool_template.description: Test the adaptation of <class> to a specific accent.

audio_clip.description: Local path to the audio file to be tested. Must be a valid WAV or MP3 file and have the pattern '^.+\.(wav|mp3)$'.

accent.description: The accent that the <class> is tested to adapt to.

test_environment.description: The environment setting where the <class> is tested, e.g., quiet room, noisy street.

quality_threshold.description: The minimum quality threshold (0-100) for the <class> to be considered successful in adapting to the accent.

evaluation_metric.description: The metric used to evaluate the adaptation of <class> to the accent, e.g., accuracy, response time.

retry_attempts.description: Number of times the adaptation test should be retried in case of failure.

feedback_enabled.description: Indicates if user feedback is considered during the <class> adaptation test.
